title: Phone Charger Apollo 11 Se Tez!
idea: A modern USB-C charger chip runs about 48x faster than the 1.024 MHz Apollo 11 Guidance Computer that landed humans on the Moon with roughly 4 KB of RAM.

lines.text: Aapka phone charger Apollo 11 ke computer se zyada smart hai!
1969 mein insaan chaand pe utra, sirf 4 KB RAM wale computer se.
Uski speed sirf 1 MHz thi, aur ek USB-C charger chip 48 MHz!
Aur aapke 8 GB phone mein uske 20 lakh guna se zyada RAM!
Aapki ek selfie bhi us poore computer mein fit nahi hoti!
Phir bhi NASA chaand tak pahunch gaya! Aap apne phone se kya karte ho?

facts.claim: The Apollo Guidance Computer had 2,048 words of erasable RAM (about 4 KB) and 36,864 words of fixed ROM, with 16-bit words, so total memory was about 76 KB
The AGC's 2.048 MHz oscillator was halved to a 1.024 MHz clock for internal operations
The Anker PowerPort Atom PD 2 USB-C charger's Cypress CYPD4225 chip runs at 48 MHz, about 48x the AGC's 1.024 MHz clock (Forrest Heller's analysis; some other chargers are weaker than the AGC)
Apollo 11's computer was less powerful than a USB-C charger chip
8 GB of RAM ÷ ~4 KB of AGC RAM = 8,388,608 KB ÷ 4 KB ≈ 2.1 million (over 20 lakh) times more (arithmetic)
